newsitem.title: USA: La-Man files lawsuit vs MCI.
newsitem.headline: La-Man files lawsuit vs MCI.

text.p: La-Man Corp and its Vision Trust Marketing Inc unit said Wednesday they filed suit against MCI Communications Corp and British Telecommunications Plc alleging breach of contract and fraud.
La-Man and its subsidiary said the lawsuit was filed Tuesday in the Circuit Court of Palm Beach County, Fla.
The company said its suit alleges MCI caused substantial financial harm and injury to the plaintiffs through "contractual breaches, misrepresentation, deceit and other wrongs."
The lawsuit seeks money damages for financial losses sustained by La-Man and Vision as a result of MCI's cancellation of a contract with Vision in November, La-Man said.

Vision Trust had been an authorized sales agent of MCI to market, sell and distribute various MCI services including domestic long distance calling to a customer base of small businesses including many minority-owned firms.
An MCI spokeswoman said the company had not yet been served with legal papers related to the case but that MCI does not comment on pending lawsuits as a matter of company policy.
British Telecom and MCI have agreed to a $20 billion merger to form a combined company known as Concert Plc. Closing of the deal awaits regulatory approvals on both sides of the Atlantic.
"We feel that the timing of the cancellation of contract and the timing of the merger with British Telecom are related events," La-Man's President William Brandner said by phone.
Brandner declined to comment further on the details of the complaint.
The law firm of Romano, Erksen and Cronin in West Palm Beach, Fla. is representing La-Man.
